name: Laser Hair Removal
description: Long-lasting hair reduction for face and body, from upper lip and underarms to full legs. Course packages available.

name: Laser Tattoo Removal
description: The laser breaks ink into tiny particles that your body clears naturally. Priced per session by size; most tattoos need several sessions spaced 6–8 weeks apart.

name: Microneedling
description: Collagen induction therapy that refines texture, softens acne scarring and fine lines, and brings back your glow.

name: Mesotherapy
description: A cocktail of vitamins, hyaluronic acid and nutrients delivered into the skin to hydrate, brighten and revitalise.

name: Chemical Peels
description: Professional peels matched to your skin to clear congestion, fade pigmentation and even out tone.

name: IV Vitamin Drips
description: Vitamin infusions to support hydration, energy and skin radiance from the inside out. A short health check is done before your first drip.

name: Skin Rejuvenation
description: Non-invasive laser toning that stimulates collagen, tightens and revitalises tired-looking skin.
